name: address-chip
title: Address Chip
description: A compact EVM address with a generated blockie-style avatar, copy button, ENS label and explorer link.

props.name: chars
props.description: Characters kept on each side of the ellipsis.

props.name: label
props.description: Display name such as an ENS name. The short address moves next to it.

props.name: href
props.description: Explorer link for the address. Opens in a new tab.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called after the address lands on the clipboard.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
